headline: Front-Line Base Struggles Ease, Contested Sectors Hold
war_summary: The latest ledger shows a front still unsettled, though several of yesterday’s liveliest sectors have gone quiet in the newest hours. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the chief furnace, with 38 strategic-base events in twenty-four hours and three in the latest two; its holdings stand four Warden to five Colonial, while casualty rates are accelerating. FishermansRowHex records 35 daily events, but none in two hours and only three in six, with all nine bases presently Colonial. StlicanShelfHex has 20 daily events and two in six, retaining a narrow five-Warden to four-Colonial division. LinnMercyHex holds at 17 events for the day and eight in six hours; its battle rates are accelerating even as enlistment growth steadies, and the ledger reads ten Colonial bases to one Warden. MooringCountyHex, now eleven events daily and five in six hours, has seen two in the latest two and renewed casualty and enlistment surges; Wardens hold eleven of twelve bases. StonecradleHex has cooled, with five daily events and none in two hours, but remains split five to four. Elsewhere, the many quiet sectors show little immediate ownership evidence.
